title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Rhubarb Custard Sweet
description: Keep your device running perfectly with the Rhubarb Custard Sweet Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack, compatible with all Vaporesso Dojo Blast kits. Featuring the clever INSTA-JUICED design, this system keeps your 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid completely separated from the coil inside its 10ml container, locking in flavour until the exact moment you assemble it. Rhubarb Custard Sweet provides a nostalgic, balanced blend that contrasts sharp British Rhubarb with smooth, creamy Vanilla custard. The tart fruit notes balance beautifully against the mellow, confectionery-inspired base, creating a highly satisfying, layered profile. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
